name: Origami Fold
summary: A world folded from washi paper: flat-lit facets, mountain and valley creases, hemmed pastel sheets and stop-motion paper puppets.
description: Every character, creature, prop, collectible and icon is a small fold mesh: flat triangular facets whose tone comes from one light in the upper left, picked from a 4-step ramp per paper colour, with every shared edge drawn as a mountain (bright) or valley (dark) crease. The paper is two-sided, so hems, inner ears, bellies, wing backs and confetti show the cream back. The ground is one huge washi sheet scored with a crease tessellation; designed sites sit on it – villages on mustard field diamonds with pleated crop ridges, orchards on blush diamonds, deep-green groves, lakes sunk below a teal shore band – joined by folded paper ribbons. Actors move like stop-motion paper puppets: held poses on 8–12 fps steps, crouch-and-hop frogs, a flapping crane, creatures that crumple into a paper ball and pop open into a flat sheet.
avoidFor: projects that need hundreds of distinct animated models

difficulty.why: Each new asset is a list of triangles with a pseudo height per vertex – shading and every crease line follow automatically, so a new creature is mostly composing kites, strips and fans. The craft is in choosing folds that read as real origami, posing a puppet over 6–8 held frames with overlapping parts (tails, ears, hems, manes) and designing the crumple/unfold sequences; both facing directions are baked from mirrored geometry so the light stays upper-left.

technique.renderer: Canvas 2D (procedural, no image assets): 2D fold meshes with pseudo heights -> per-facet flat tone -> automatic crease classification -> baked sprites
technique.resolution: Native resolution. Sprites are baked at K = clamp(round(screenHeight/360 * 1.6), 3, 8) px per world unit (4 px/unit at 900 px); the ground is baked in 256-unit chunks at up to 2.5 px/unit (groundResMax 2.5).
technique.summary: Shapes are triangle lists in screen space with a z height per vertex; the facet normal against one light picks 1 of 4 tones, and each shared edge is drawn as a mountain (bright) or valley (dark) crease depending on the fold direction. Every pose is baked once into a sprite; mirrored copies are rebuilt (not flipped) so light stays upper-left. Motion is a sequence of these held poses, not interpolation.
technique.linework: No ink outline. Open paper edges are stroked in the ramp's deep tone mixed 38 % toward ink #2a2433 at 0.55 units; mountain folds 0.3 units in the light tone mixed 55 % with white; valley folds 0.3 units in the deep tone mixed 15 % toward ink; seams between two paper colours at alpha 0.45. Round joins and caps. Each facet is also stroked in its own fill colour to hide anti-aliasing seams. Closed eyes and squeezed eyes are 0.45-0.5 unit ink lines.
technique.shading: Flat per facet. d = n·L with L = normalize(-0.55, -0.45, 0.7) (x right, y down the screen, z towards the viewer); tone = d > 0.8 light, > 0.55 base, > 0.3 shade, else deep. Far legs, far sleeves and far wings add +1 tone for depth. Hit and fall poses re-bake the same mesh with every shared vertex jittered (crumple 0.8-1.6), so the facets catch new tones like crushed paper. No gradients inside a facet.
technique.lighting: One soft light from the upper left for everything (models, ground relief, sheet drop shadows, water pleats, ribbons). Cast shadows are the sprite silhouette tinted rgb(78,56,72), sheared to the lower right (x' = x - 0.62*y, y' = -0.36*y around the feet), blurred 1.1-1.6 units at alpha 0.24-0.32, plus a contact ellipse. A screen overlay adds warm light rgba(255,250,235,.16) at the upper left and plum shade rgba(90,64,80,.14) at the lower right with a soft vignette rgba(96,70,70,.17).
technique.texture: Paper fibre: a 160 px tileable canvas of 420 short curved fibres (white at alpha 0.3-0.65, brown rgba(120,92,64,0.1-0.22)) plus 900 speckles, laid over every sprite with source-atop at 0.55 and over the ground at 0.5. The ground sheet keeps a faint relief of its folds: every 160-unit panel has its own crease pattern (pyramids, waterbomb, pleats, twist) shown with a large-scale calm/busy variation.

paletteRules: Every paper colour is a 4-step ramp (light / base / shade / deep); the light picks the step per facet – never invent in-between colours or gradients.
The ground is pale washi (white #f4eee1 and pastel sheets); everything standing on it uses the saturated mid-value ramps, so actors pop by value and hue.
Each ground sheet has a meaning: mustard = village field, blush = orchard, deep green = grove, teal = shore. Do not use them as random patches.
Kami paper is two-sided: wherever a sheet turns over (hems, ribbon folds, bellies, inner ears, wing undersides, confetti backs) use the cream ramp.

Main character = coral + indigo + cream + dark paws; small creatures = teal / sage / mustard; fast creature = blush; large creature = plum with a mustard mane – keep creature hues off the main character.
Water is the only large saturated ground area (#88a8d8) and always sits below the paper with a shore band and an inner shadow.
Shadows are plum rgb(78,56,72) at low alpha, never black or grey; no pure black anywhere (darkest is #201c27).

typography.role: Titles, counters, card titles, floating numbers
typography.css: font: 900 32px/1.05 'Zen Maru Gothic', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .05em; color: #3b4a87; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 rgba(255,251,243,.9);

Handwritten notes: labels, hints, families – like pencil on the paper

world.summary: One endless sheet of washi paper scored with a crease tessellation (40-unit squares with both diagonals). Designed sites – one per 520 x 520 block – give the sheet its regions: villages on mustard field diamonds, orchards on blush diamonds, groves on deep-green sheets inside meadows, lakes sunk below a teal shore band. Every border follows the crease grid, so edges are straight 45° folds with a cream hem and a soft drop shadow. Folded paper ribbons run from doorstep to doorstep between neighbouring sites, and grass gathers in clumps where something happens.
layers: Crease tessellation: 40-unit squares, each split into 4 triangles (N, E, S, W) by its diagonals. Every cell gets one region; a higher sheet also fills the cell triangle where it wraps around two sides, so staircases become straight 45° folds.

Sites (one per 520-unit block, jittered): 36 % village (field diamond |dx|+|dy| < 104-140), 24 % orchard (blush diamond 82-108), 24 % grove (deep-green sheet, radius 100-140 wobbled by noise), 16 % open paper. The area around the start is composed by hand. Meadows come from fbm(x/470) > 0.53 and a 1.6x halo around groves; lakes from fbm(x/720) > 0.64 with a shore band from 0.607.

Stacking order bottom to top: water, shore, base, meadow, grove, field and blossom. Before each layer its union is filled twice offset (+1.3,+1.6) alpha 0.09 and (+2.6,+3.2) alpha 0.07 in rgba(84,60,58) – a drop shadow onto the lower sheets (x1.25 deeper for the base over the shore).

Hems: along every edge that borders a lower sheet, a 2.4-unit strip inside the sheet in its colour mixed 55 % toward #fffcf4, with a fold line rgba(96,72,60,.22) and the paper edge rgba(96,72,60,.34).

Relief: every 160-unit panel has its own crease pattern (42 % pyramids, 26 % waterbomb checker, 16 % horizontal pleats, 16 % twist); triangle tone x (1 + relief*amp); a large-scale noise makes some panels calm and flat, others busy.
Water: chevron pleats (period 18, row 11, amplitude 3.4) – shaded slope #6d8cc6, valley line, lit slope #a9c3ea, ridge line rgba(255,255,255,.7); small cream three-facet wave crests.

Crease lines: mountain diagonals rgba(255,253,246,.7) 0.45 with a faint shadow twin, valley lines rgba(98,76,60,.16), grid lines rgba(98,76,60,.13); major folds every 160 units in diagram notation – valley dashed [5, 3.5] indigo, mountain dash-dot [7, 2.5, 1.2, 2.5] coral – fading with the panel calmness.

Ribbons: 11-14 units wide, four straight runs with small random offsets, folded flat at every bend along the bisector (mitred), runs alternating front #e8d9bc and back #faf5ea, edge rgba(120,92,64,.38), dashed centre crease, fold crease rgba(96,70,52,.5), drop shadow (+1.4,+1.9) alpha 0.1. Never across water.
Paper fibre over the whole chunk at alpha 0.5.

Decals, stamped from baked sprites: grass clumps of 3-7 folded tufts (3 cuts, sage or pine, golden-angle spiral, biggest in the middle) at sheet edges, ribbon verges and shores; flowers only in small drifts; pebbles on shores; field crop ridges – pleated sage ridges 3.2 units wide on the 45° grid, every 12 units, double rows with a fallow gap, tapered ends, pine sprouts every 7 units, cut short around houses and fences; rare two-tone scraps and curved indigo fold arrows on open paper.

characters.summary: Fold meshes of 10-60 facets in 3/4 side view, baked as held poses for both facing directions (mirrored geometry, re-lit). The main character (~14 units wide in the kimono, ~24 with the tail, ~36 tall to the ear tips) is a coral origami fox: faceted head with a raised muzzle peak, kite ears with cream inner sides, an indigo kimono folded down the middle with a mustard sash and cream hem, counter-swinging sleeves with cream cuffs, dark ink paws and a big kite tail with a cream tip – 20 poses. Creatures: a jumping frog (small, teal / sage / mustard, cream belly, 7 poses), a paper crane (fast, blush, hovers 8 units up, 6 wing poses showing the cream back on the down-stroke) and a plum folded boar (large, ~48 x 42 units, 8 walk poses) with a mustard spiked mane, tail tuft, cream tusk and belly band.
rules: Build everything from kites (two triangles folded along an axis), folded strips (legs, necks, tails) and fans around one raised point (heads, bodies, crowns); the raised point sets where the light breaks.
Keep 2-3 colours per model plus the cream back side; the main character is the only coral-and-indigo figure.
Silhouette first: big ears, tails, wings and manes are the readable shapes – details are only ink dot eyes (0.75-0.85 units, white catch-light) and a dot nose, clustered on the face.
Never flip a sprite with a negative scale: rebuild the mirrored mesh so the light stays in the upper left.
Main character poses: 3 idle breaths, the same 3 with closed eyes (blink), ear flick, 8 walk poses (contact, down, passing, up per foot), dash, dash landing, hurt (crumpled), throw, down.
Overlapping parts lag one pose behind the body: tail tip, ear tips, kimono hem and the boar's mane tips are offset by the previous pose's bob, so they follow through.

Frog: sit, sit with throat puff, blink, crouch, launch (stretched, back leg thrown out), airborne (legs tucked), landing squash. Crane: up, half, down-stroke, low, recovery, half. Boar: 8-pose lateral-sequence walk, each leg 3/4 of the cycle on the ground.
Every creature runs on its own phase from its seed (hop phase, flap step, walk phase) and its own size (frog 0.95-1.05, boar 0.96-1.04), so a crowd never moves in lock-step.

props.summary: Folded scenery baked with the same fold engine and light, placed by design: villages get 2-3 houses with tulip clusters and accordion screens, a pinwheel and a tree on the rim; orchards are a diamond grid of round trees around a tulip bed; groves are clusters of tiered pines ringed by bushes and a boulder; shores grow reeds and stones; lakes carry lotus clusters and paper boats. Open paper stays calm: stones beside the ribbons, the odd shrub or tree.
rules: Pines (3 variants: two pine green heights, one teal): three kite tiers folded down the middle so the left half is lit, on a wood strip trunk.
Round trees (4 variants: coral, mustard, sage, teal): crown of 8 outer + 8 inner points and a raised apex (24 facets) on a strip trunk with one branch.
Bushes (sage, pine, teal) are 2-3 folded lobes; boulders (3 variants) are a fan of 7 jittered points around a raised point at the upper left.
House (coral or indigo roof): front wall folded at the middle, side wall in the cream shade, indigo door, mustard window, roof as one folded triangle with two cream squash-fold flaps.
Tulips (2 colour orders of coral / mustard / blush), reeds (2), accordion screen (cream and teal pleats), pinwheel (12 baked rotation frames, coral and teal blades, 9 fps).
Paper boats (mustard, coral, cream) and lotus sit only on water, bob 0.8 units and rock ±0.05 rad with an expanding cream ripple ellipse.
Paper on a stand sways in the breeze: a slow rotation per prop (reeds 0.05, tulips 0.035, trees 0.014-0.016 rad) plus gusts that roll across the world from the left.

Every land prop casts the same sheared, blurred plum shadow as the characters; tall props turn 50 % translucent when the main character is behind them; the start area keeps a 100-unit radius free of tall props.

effects.name: Paper-plane projectile
effects.how: A folded dart (cream wings with coral tips, valley crease down the middle) baked at 16 angles so the light stays upper-left, banking ±0.2 rad in flight, with its own soft shadow 7 units below and two short pencil dashes #7a6c74 behind it.

effects.name: Orbiting shuriken
effects.how: A two-tone origami throwing star (coral and teal arms around a raised centre) baked in 8 rotation frames over 90°, spinning at 30 frames per second, bobbing 1.2 units over a soft shadow blob.

effects.name: Collectibles
effects.how: Small: a mustard lucky star (6 rotation frames at 5 fps). Large: a teal folded crystal (8 frames at 8 fps). Both bob 3 ± 1.2 units on held 12 fps steps, each on its own phase, over a plum blob shadow; spawned ones pop up 10 units with an outBack scale. On collect: a tinted 4-point sparkle and the star swelling to 1.9x while lifting 9 units in 0.3 s.

effects.name: Impact
effects.how: Layered in 4 parts: core = a crisp cream 4-point folded sparkle for 0.13 s; main = three crease lines snapping open in a fan around the hit direction (a lit mountain line beside a dark valley line, 0.17 s, outQuad); secondary = three two-tone paper shards flung along the hit with gravity 260; residue = one cream fleck drifting down for 0.65 s.

effects.name: Crumple and unfold
effects.how: When a creature vanishes: flash 0.16 s, 8 (large: 12) two-tone kite petals shoot out and fold shut again (sin envelope), 7 (14) two-sided confetti triangles flutter, and the flat sheet left on the ground folds itself back up in held steps over 1.1 s (open, half, closed, shrink and fade). The large creature adds a plum dash-dot crease ring and a short screen shake.

effects.name: Two-sided confetti
effects.how: Flat triangles that flip with cos(t*9): the colour front (light/base tone) when positive, the cream back when negative, with a gentle sideways sway, gravity 40-120 and high drag so they flutter.

effects.name: Glow-up
effects.how: A pale-gold sparkle, a dash-dot mustard crease ellipse opening to 40 units and a dashed indigo one 0.12 s later, a ground ring of 10 mustard/coral petals plus 8 teal/cream petals, and 22 confetti triangles drifting down from 30-46 units; the main character turns once like a card (horizontal scale cos(2πt), mirrored sprite on the back half).

effects.name: Dash strips
effects.how: Thin folded paper strips (light/shade halves) in cream and indigo trail behind the dash direction, plus two cream cut-out afterimages of the main character 8 units apart at alpha 0.42/i.

effects.name: Floating numbers
effects.how: Zen Maru Gothic 900 in indigo #3b4a87 with a cream #fffbf3 border; emphasised values are deep coral #9b4136 on a folded mustard tag (two halves #f8d372 / #e6ae42 with a cream crease). They unfold vertically from a crease (outBack, 14 % of their life) and fold away in the last 22 %.

atmosphere.summary: A calm, evenly lit paper table: one soft light from the upper left, sheared plum drop shadows to the lower right, layered sheets casting short offset shadows, a faint warm light gradient across the screen, paper props swaying in slow gusts and a few origami butterflies drifting over the paper.
rules: One light direction for everything: L = normalize(-0.55, -0.45, 0.7); shadows always fall to the lower right.

Cast shadow = silhouette tinted rgb(78,56,72), sheared x' = x - 0.62*y, y' = -0.36*y, blurred 1.1 units (props and the large creature 1.4-1.6), alpha 0.3 (crane 0.24, props 0.28) + contact ellipse; hopping and flying things get a flattened shadow that shrinks with height (1 - lift*0.04).
Screen overlay baked once per size: linear gradient from rgba(255,250,235,.16) at the upper left to rgba(90,64,80,.14) at the lower right, plus a radial vignette to rgba(96,70,70,.17).

Ambient life is slower than the actors: butterflies (two kite wings, beats on 12 fps steps open - half - closed - half with held glides) on a 230-unit grid, 22 ± 4 units above their shadows; prop sway at 0.4-0.9 rad/s.
No glow, no bloom, no fog – paper is matte; brightness differences come from facets only.
Modal overlays: indigo tint linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(59,74,135,.34), rgba(40,52,98,.5)) with a diagonal crease grid of rgba(255,250,240,.13) lines every 64 px.

ui.summary: UI is folded paper: bars are cream strips folded lengthwise (top half lighter, bottom half shaded) with pleated fills, the clock is an envelope with a flap and diagonal creases, counters are paper tabs with a dog-eared corner, the caption bar is a note folded down the middle and cards are envelopes with a coloured flap triangle (coral, teal, mustard) that unfold (rotateX from the top edge) into place, the title is a coral ribbon with notched ends. Hard offset shadows rgba(82,60,72,.15), 1 px edges rgba(120,96,80,.24), no rounded corners.

motion: Stop-motion timing: every actor switches between baked poses on held steps (8-12 fps); only position, a small squash and a lean are continuous.

Main character walk: 8 poses per cycle (one cycle = 6.2 animation units ≈ 0.67 s at walking speed ≈ 12 fps), stride 4.4 units, foot lift 2.4, body bob 0.3 / -0.3 / 0.8 / 1.3 per half step, lean 0.07-0.095 rad; sleeves counter-swing the feet; tail, ear tips and hem lag one pose.

Main character idle: breathing on 8 fps steps over 2.5 s (neutral - in, held 0.75 s - neutral - out, held 0.75 s), blink every 3.7 s for 0.17 s, ear flick every 6.3 s for 0.36 s; throw pose while aiming with a 3 % recoil squash.

Dash: lean 0.22 rad, ears swept back, tail streaming, squash 1.1 / 0.93 lifted 1.2 units, then a landing pose (squash 1.06 / 0.95) for 0.14 s. Hurt: crumpled pose with squash 1.08 / 0.92 and a cream flash, then blinking at 12 fps while untouchable.

Small creature hop on 9 held steps: crouch 20 % (squash 1.05 / 0.94, anticipation) - launch - airborne arc 6.5 units with nose-up tilt -0.16 then +0.1 rad - landing squash 1.08 / 0.9 - sit with throat puff and blinks; phase anim*0.38 + seed*3.

Fast creature: 12 fps flap sequence up (held 2 steps) - half - down-stroke - low - recovery - half; the body rises up to 1.6 units on the down-stroke and the neck bobs; hover 8 ± 1.6 units, banking ±0.12 rad with its velocity.
Large creature: 8-pose lateral-sequence walk, body bobs twice per cycle (0-1.1 units), head nods ±1, mane tips lag the bob, tail wags ±2.4.
Hit (crease pop): crumpled hit pose squashed 1.16 / 0.84 for ~80 ms with a cream flash on the first frames, then a spring-back 0.95 / 1.06 until ~120 ms.

Vanish 0.35 s in 5 held steps: crumple + flash - squeeze - crumpled paper ball tossed up 6 units - ball lands - pops open into a flat sheet; the crane is crushed and its loose sheet see-saws down. The left sheet folds itself away over the next 1.1 s.

Appear 0.45 s in 6 held steps: a folded packet drops in, half-opens, opens flat; the creature rises out of it squashed (1.22 / 0.42) - stretched (0.9 / 1.18) - settles (1.05 / 0.93) while the sheet shrinks and fades. The crane: a loose sheet see-saws down from 30 units, then the crane pops in with pinched wings and a 1.12 overshoot.
Glow-up: one card-flip turn in the first third of a second; numbers unfold from a crease in 14 % of their life and fold away in the last 22 %.
HUD cards unfold from their top edge (perspective rotateX −88° -> 0) in 0.6 s, staggered 0.08 s; the title ribbon unfolds horizontally (scaleX 0.05 -> 1) in 0.5 s.
do: Model every asset as facets with a z height per vertex and let one shared light choose 1 of 4 tones per facet.
Draw shared edges as creases: bright for mountain folds, dark for valley folds; stroke only open edges as paper edges.
Show the cream back of the paper wherever a sheet turns over – hems, ribbon folds, bellies, inner ears, wing backs, confetti.
Animate with held poses (8-12 fps) and let tails, ears, hems and manes lag one pose behind the body.
Give every region a reason: villages on fields, orchards on blossom diamonds, groves in meadows, reeds at shores; connect sites with folded ribbons.
Gather grass in clumps at edges, verges and shores and leave open paper calm.
Bake both facing directions from mirrored geometry so the light never flips.
Lift every folded object with a soft plum shadow falling to the lower right.
dont: Don't use smooth gradients, soft airbrush shading or rounded blobs – paper folds are straight.
Don't add thick black outlines; edges are paper edges in the colour's deep tone.
Don't mirror sprites with negative scale – the light would jump to the right.
Don't tween poses smoothly or animate everything with one shared sine – it stops looking like paper puppets.
Don't cut organic, torn or scissor-cut silhouettes – that is cut-paper, not origami.
Don't scatter tufts and flowers evenly over the ground or fill it with saturated colour; it must stay quiet behind the actors.
Don't make shadows black or grey, and don't let them point in different directions.
Don't use glows, bloom or neon – paper is matte.
performance: All fold meshes are baked at init together with their blurred shadow sprites: main character 20 poses x 2 directions (blink poses share the idle shadows), 3 frog colours x 7 poses + 3 crumpled poses, 6 crane and 8 boar poses + crumpled ones, 5 paper balls, 24 prop variants, 12 pinwheel frames, 16 plane angles, 8 shuriken, 6 star and 8 crystal frames, 4 butterflies and 23 ground-decal sprites (12 tufts, 9 flowers, 2 pebbles). Hit flashes are lazily tinted copies. Per frame only drawImage blits, a few particle paths and one full-screen overlay. Ground chunks (256 units, up to 640 px) are vector-drawn by a generator that yields per layer and every 8 crop ridges, with caches for sites, cell regions and ribbons. Triangles are grouped by colour (relief quantised to 0.25 % steps) into a few dozen fill + seam-stroke paths per layer, crease lines are batched into a few paths per 160-unit panel, and decals and crop sprouts are stamped from the baked sprites (no per-decal mesh) – about 4-5 ms of script per chunk. ctx.filter blur is used only at bake time.
